title: Exact gap-conditioned first-return precision

theorem.statement: For every return gap r in {2,3,4,5} and every target width k>=5, the conditioned map z -> R(z) mod 2^k requires exactly k+2r source-coordinate bits.
theorem.consequence: Knowing the realized return gap does not reduce the exact causal-cone precision budget. A fixed-width suffix cannot be made exact by carrying the gap sequence alongside it.

scientific_boundary: This theorem ranges over all compatible return coordinates. It does not determine the unique zero-initialized actual orbit, prove permanent avoidance of consecutive gap-two cylinders, prove phase-witness complexity divergence, exclude eventual center period two, or solve Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.
